q_coolWater.ask: Did you cool it under cool water for 20 minutes?
q_coolWater.help:
Running water soon after the burn.
Cooling limits how deep it goes.

q_tightLump.ask: Is the swelling growing or feeling tight?
q_tightLump.help:
A hard, growing lump.
Bleeding can build up and press on nerves.

q_swellSite.help:
The body part that is swollen.
The place tells the cause.

q_sprainSite.help:
The joint that was hurt.
Different joints have different checks.

q_boneSite.help:
The body part hurt.
Hip, back, neck and head need urgent care.

q_biteBy.help:
The kind of animal.
Some bites carry rabies or venom.

q_skinBroken.ask: Did the bite break the skin?
q_skinBroken.help:
Teeth went through the skin.
Broken skin can get infected.

q_biteSite.ask: Is it on the face, hand, joint or private part?
q_biteSite.help:
The bite is on a risky spot.
These sites are easily harmed.

q_spreadSwell.ask: Is the swelling bigger than a palm or growing?
q_spreadSwell.help:
Red swelling that keeps spreading.
It can be infection or a big reaction.

q_hivesBody.ask: Any hives or itch away from the sting?
q_hivesBody.help:
Raised itchy patches on other skin.
This can be the start of a serious allergy.

q_coughStrong.help:
A loud, forceful cough.
A strong cough may clear it.

q_cannotSpeak.ask: Can they not speak, cough or breathe?
q_cannotSpeak.help:
No sound, no air.
The airway is blocked.

q_blueLips.ask: Are the lips or face turning blue?
q_blueLips.help:
Blue or grey colour.
Not enough air is getting in.

q_lostResponse.ask: Have they gone floppy or stopped responding?
q_lostResponse.help:
No answer when spoken to.
This is an emergency.

q_stuckFeeling.ask: Does it still feel stuck after it passed?
q_stuckFeeling.help:
Food or object feels stuck in throat.
It may still block or scratch the gullet.

q_legTurned.ask: Is the leg shorter or turned outward?
q_legTurned.help:
The foot points out or the leg looks short.
This is a sign of a broken hip.

q_openSore.ask: Any open sore, blister or black skin?
q_openSore.help:
Broken skin on the foot.
Foot sores can turn serious, especially with diabetes.
